annotatedSteps.description: Calculate radius from diameter and set up distance equation
annotatedSteps.studentWork:
Radius = diameter/2 = 10√2/2 = 5√2 units.
Distance between the centre (2a, a − 7) and (11, −9) = radius
⇒ (2a − 11)² + (a − 7 + 9)² = (5√2)² = 50
